notes: v2.5.27. The 3D viewer has one set of tools with a toolbar row for the tool you pick, a 3D lens, Section planes in one place, a smooth Peel, custom filters saved to your account, an all-fact search, a fuller selection card, a model in its own window, GLB export for customers and a resource monitor; laptops with two graphics cards draw on the stronger one. Small 3D models no longer wait behind a giant one, models are prepared on CATIA server 2, the queue recovers by itself, and models can be prepared on release with a cache cleanup in Controls. Engineers can add a part to an assembly from the 3D viewer, with a warning and a banner if a CATIA save undoes it. Every model door has 3D model and CATIA rows. The eBOM Status cell is one chip and + Planner lands on the project board. Lots made by mistake can be removed, retired lots can't be drawn on, consumables can be taken off the list, PO and Planner dates read as calendar days, and the NCR History tab no longer covers the tabs.
